scope: Selected corroborating assertions, not a full patch audit or task test execution. Patch line numbers, not patched repository line numbers.

checks.observation: An absent defaulted field is failed, the fallback value exists, and is_complete is false.
Failed required fields prevent values; partial nested values can survive with the parent marked failed.
Refinement repairs failures while ignoring attempts to replace already successful fields.
Extra keys with forbid_extra_keys preserve a value but mark incompleteness.
A merge strategy without its key appends defaults before user values.
A parent strategy does not turn an unannotated child array replacement into append.
Merging a changed nested map leaves chart defaults unchanged.

checks.test: non-identical reference values reported as changed in world diff
checks.observation: Empty and absent relations are equivalent, but distinct nested reference values compare changed under shallow equality.

checks.test: snapshot deep copy - modifying entity after snapshot does not affect snapshot data
checks.observation: Snapshot trait data remains unchanged after the entity is updated; this particular fixture does not itself prove recursive copy depth.
String serialization reparses an equivalent timezone-aware recurrence.
Inline timezone definitions win over the supplied lookup.
